touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Harlaxton qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF SAINT MARY AND SAINT PETER and Harlaxton village cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Harlaxton: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Harlaxton offers CHURCH OF SAINT MARY AND SAINT PETER, Harlaxton village cross, K6 KIOSK 10 METRES SOUTH WEST OF VILLAGE CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
